predictions = clf.predict(test_x.T)

cm = confusion_matrix(test_y.flatten(), predictions, labels=clf.classes_)
disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix=cm, display_labels=clf.classes_)

disp.plot()
plt.show()
